meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 装上后，把一段文字（文章、笔记、话题等）交给 Claude，它会生成一部“无脸解说视频”：不采集网站或实景素材，而是逐场设计排版、抽象图形、图表等视觉；还会搭好项目、写分镜和脚本、按需配音频，逐帧做成页面，最后渲染成 mp4。
howto.when: 当你把一段文字（文章、笔记、话题或简报）交给 Claude，要求做成无脸讲解视频——比如概念拆解、教程、清单盘点——时接管；不适用于从网站录屏做宣传片，需求不明会先去 /hyperframes 确认。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成一个三分钟的无脸解说视频。
say.note: 你会先看到分镜草稿，确认后才继续。

say.text: 用明显是男声的旁白，把这份笔记做成概念拆解短视频。
say.note: 默认配音是女声；只有明确要求才会换成男声。

say.text: 用这段文字做无脸视频，完全不要旁白和背景音乐。

howto.what_en: Feed it text; it makes a faceless explainer video — no site/footage capture; visuals (typography, graphics, charts) designed scene by scene. It scaffolds the project, writes storyboard/script, adds audio as needed, builds frames, renders mp4.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you give it a text (article/notes/topic/brief) and ask for a faceless explainer video — e.g. concept breakdown, how-to, listicle. Not for website-tour promos; if intent is unclear, it routes through /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article on compound interest into a three-minute faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: You'll review the storyboard before it continues.

say_en.text: Narrate with an obviously male voice and turn my notes into a concept-breakdown short.
say_en.note: Default voice is female; only an explicit request switches it.

say_en.text: Make a faceless video from this text with no voiceover and no background music.
say_en.note: Only the music:none marker plus no script makes a fully silent project.
